voice_description: Native Japanese, standard Japanese. An adult female character in a dramatic fantasy anime. A gentle, sincere voice with a resilient core. Quiet thanks should sound intimate and natural; a plea for someone else should carry emotional conviction. Clear spoken delivery that can grow into a determined magical invocation. Studio-quality recording.
text:
ありがとう……
どうしてここに？
その子に触らないで！
お父様……その子だけは、帰して。
灰に眠る、かすかな光よ。
この手に、宿れ。
もう一度、燃えよ――
星火。
